item.title: At least six people killed in Ukrainian missile attack on Russia’s Belgorod

item.title: Rare Pallas’s cat captured on camera in northern Iran mountains

item.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake

item.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
item.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.
